The '''''Outlaw''''' was a [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] that may have participated in the effort to rescue [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Spy/Legends|spies]] shortly before the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]]. Just after the battle, the [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]] was seen [[Hyperspace/Legends|jumping]] out of the area. Scans would reveal that the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was carrying [[Spice/Legends|spice]].

The ''Outlaw'' participated in the [[Ambush of Rebel Alliance Frigate Rehz'nor|Ambush of Rebel Alliance frigate ''Rehz'nor'']], taking part in the resupply operation and withdrawing to hyperspace after firing all of its missiles at the attacking [[Galactic Empire]] fighters. Its cargo/passenger (possibly pilot) was only known as a "High Ranking Rebel Commander".
